input_data_model.description: Tables that a bank must (or may) provide to AML AI as input for training/prediction.

tables.name: Party
tables.description: Covers retail or commercial banking customers; enables AML AI to understand details of each party and how they changed over time.

fields.name: party_id
fields.description: Unique customer identifier (pseudo-ID or internal ID)

fields.name: source_system
fields.description: System data origin for lineage tracking

fields.name: addresses
fields.description: Address details (street, building, postal code, town, subregion, region_code)

fields.name: birth_date
fields.description: Date of birth for natural persons

fields.name: assets_value_range
fields.description: Approximate asset holdings with start/end amounts

tables.name: AccountPartyLink
tables.description: Represents how parties are related to accounts, including all account holders (not just primary) and joint holdings.

tables.name: Transaction
tables.description: Represents a movement of funds from or to an account; helps models understand the flow of money.

fields.name: transaction_id
fields.description: Unique transaction ID from account perspective

fields.name: type
fields.description: CARD, CASH, CHECK, WIRE, OTHER, or CRYPTO

fields.name: direction
fields.description: DEBIT or CREDIT from account perspective

tables.name: InteractionEvent
tables.description: A subset of AML-relevant interactions between the party and the bank, e.g. a login event to online banking.

fields.name: type
fields.description: LOGIN, PAYMENT_METHOD_ADDED, KYC_CHANGE, PASSWORD_CHANGE, or OTHER

fields.name: ip_address
fields.description: Device IP details (type, ip/obfuscated_ip, region_code, is_vpn)

tables.name: RiskCaseEvent
tables.description: Tracks the progress of a risk case from the initial alert to the case outcome; supports creation of training labels for training, tuning, and backtesting of models.

fields.name: type
fields.description: AML_SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY_START, AML_SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY_END, AML_PROCESS_START, AML_PROCESS_END, AML_ALERT_GOOGLE, AML_ALERT_LEGACY, AML_ALERT_ADHOC, AML_ALERT_EXPLORATORY, AML_ALERT_EXTERNAL, AML_SAR, AML_EXIT

tables.name: PartySupplementaryData
tables.description: Lets you add supplementary data for parties to enhance model performance with additional, relevant Party data.

tables.name: RetailPartiesRegistration
tables.description: Used for importing/registering retail customers for AML AI processing (see register-parties guide).

tables.name: CommercialPartiesRegistration
tables.description: Used for importing/registering commercial customers for AML AI processing (see register-parties guide).

fields.name: party_size
fields.description: SMALL or LARGE, based on monthly transaction volume

relationships.note: optional; may reference an external institution

output_data_model.description: Tables produced by AML AI as prediction/explainability/metadata output, written to BigQuery destinations configured by the customer.

tables.name: RiskScores
tables.description: Party-level suspicious activity risk score for a given risk period.

fields.name: risk_period_end_time
fields.description: The end of the target period, in the timezone of the dataset

fields.name: risk_score
fields.description: Prediction value between 0 and 1; higher score means higher risk

tables.name: Explainability
tables.description: Feature-family attributions explaining each party's risk score.

fields.name: risk_period_end_time
fields.description: Period end timestamp in dataset timezone

fields.name: attributions
fields.description: Record of feature families and their attribution value

tables.name: RegisteredPartiesExport
tables.destination: BigQuery table specified in the dataset field of the export request
tables.description: Export of parties registered for AML AI processing, with tiering/lifecycle metadata.

fields.name: party_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the party in the instance's datasets

fields.name: party_size
fields.description: Tier designation (NULL for retail; SMALL/LARGE for commercial)

fields.name: earliest_remove_time
fields.description: The earliest time at which the party can be removed

fields.name: registration_or_uptier_time
fields.description: The time at which the party was registered or uptiered

tables.name: ExportedMetadata
tables.destination: BigQuery table associated with engine configs, models, backtest results, or prediction results
tables.description: Generic metadata/metrics export table used across multiple AML AI resource types.

fields.name: resource_type
fields.description: Type of AML AI resource, such as an engine config or prediction results

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the metadata entry, such as a metric

input_to_output_linkages.note: Risk score is produced per party in the input Party table
Explainability attributions are produced per party
Registered parties export mirrors registration input, plus lifecycle metadata
Backtest recall metrics are computed per risk typology defined via RiskCaseEvent

input_to_output_linkages.from: input tables (Party, AccountPartyLink, Transaction, InteractionEvent, RiskCaseEvent, PartySupplementaryData)
input_to_output_linkages.note: Missingness/importance metrics are computed over the feature families derived from input tables
